Guards.Name: Ask for a target
Guards.Hint: When an attack, heal or ally ability is used with no token targeted, pick the target first, before any focus or Investiture is spent.

HealPrompts.Name: Prompt target-rolled healing
HealPrompts.Hint: After Field Medicine or Progression (Regrowth), ask the target's player to roll their healing and apply it.

StrikeTargeting.Name: Ask for a target on weapon Strikes
StrikeTargeting.Hint: Off by default: a Strike rolls against whatever is targeted, or just rolls with no target. Turn on to get the target picker for Strikes too.

Apply.NeedSelected: No tokens to apply to. Apply buttons use your selected tokens (click a token you control). Targeted tokens (T) are ignored unless you change the Cosmere RPG setting "Apply buttons to" to "Prioritise targeted".
Apply.NeedTargeted: No tokens to apply to. Apply buttons use your targeted tokens: hover a token and press T, then click again.
Apply.NeedEither: No tokens to apply to. Select a token you control, or target one (hover it and press T), then click again.

Abilities.TalentHint: Use its actions from the Actions tab: {names}

Onboarding.Title: Apply buttons
Onboarding.Content: Damage and healing Apply buttons currently only affect tokens you have selected. Players can't select enemy tokens, so the buttons seem to do nothing. Switch Cosmere RPG's "Apply buttons to" to Prioritise targeted (targeted tokens first, otherwise selected)? Foundry will reload.

Audit.Title: Ability audit
Audit.Copied: Audit report copied to the clipboard as Markdown.
Audit.ConfirmContent: Change {name} ({location}): {fix}? This edits the document directly.

Reason.skill-test-heal: Has a skill test and a healing formula, so it rolls as an attack against the target's defences.
Reason.skill-test-damage-not-attack: Has a skill test and a damage formula, so it rolls as an attack, but nothing in its name or description describes an attack.
Reason.charges-not-consumed: Has charges or ammo, but none of its actions spend them, so using it never asks to consume a charge or lowers the count.

Abilities.StrikeHint: This doesn't roll by itself: make the attack with your weapon's Strike, then apply this effect.

Heal.RepeatHint: Roll again at the start of each of the target's turns while the infusion lasts.
Heal.NotOwner: Only {name}'s owner can roll this healing.
Heal.AlreadyRolled: This healing has already been rolled.
Heal.TestSuccess: Medicine test {total} vs DC {dc}: success. Recovery die + Medicine ranks.
Heal.TestFailure: Medicine test {total} vs DC {dc}: failure. Recovery die only.
Heal.UnknownOutcome: Test result not found: rolling the recovery die only. Add {ranks} if the DC {dc} test succeeded.
Heal.RegrowthNote: Regrowth: recover this at the start of each of your turns while infused.
